tagline: Only 5 m from the sea, island of Cres
metaDesc: Apartment Punta Orange in Pogana Bay, Punta Križa, island of Cres: first-floor apartment for up to 3 guests, 5 m from the sea, with a fantastic sea view, terrace, air conditioning and free Wi-Fi.
summary: First-floor apartment with a fantastic sea view from every window and a terrace by the sea.
body:
The holiday house Blue & Orange is situated in Pogana Bay, Punta Križa, only 5 m from the sea, and has two cosy apartments, Punta Orange and Punta Blue, with air conditioning and free Wi-Fi.

The apartment Punta Orange on the first floor consists of a kitchen, a seating area and a couch that can be extended into a bed. The twin-bedded room has a closet and bed linen. The bathroom has a shower and towels.

A nice terrace with a seating area for four, a few steps from the sea, is at the guests’ disposal. Fantastic sea view from the apartment. An amazing choice for holidays!
goodToKnow:
Please collect the keys at Restaurant Pogana, a few steps from the apartment.
Free public parking is available about 90 m from the apartment.
The whole apartment and the terrace area are at the guests’ disposal.
The tap water is safe for drinking.
The Wi-Fi login and password can be found in the apartment.
